* The intercostal muscles contract, expanding the ribcage.
* The diaphragm contracts, pulling downwards to increase the volume of the chest.
* Pressure inside the chest is lowered and air is sucked into the lungs.

When you breathe out (exhalation):

* Your diaphragm relaxes and moves upward into the chest cavity.
* The intercostal muscles between the ribs also relax to reduce the space in the chest cavity.
* Air rich in carbon dioxide is forced out of your lungs and windpipe, and then out of your nose or mouth.

Float the PoachPod in the boiling water, ensuring it remains upright and no water gets inside. Cover the pot with a lid and let the egg cook for about six minutes. After cooking, use a large slotted spoon or tongs to lift the PoachPod out of the hot water. question: what is the difference between sms and mms
answer: SMS stands for Short Message Service, commonly referred to as a text message, and allows you to send a text message of up to 160 characters to another device. MMS, which stands for Multimedia Messaging Service, is an evolution of SMS. It allows you to send messages that include pictures, video, or audio content to another device. MMS messages can carry a larger size of content up to 300KB. SMS is restricted to sending text-only messages, whereas MMS allows a combination of text, pictures, sounds, and videos.
